objective: Find reproducible computer-science results with a defensible difference from prior work and a measured route to practical use.

tracks.title: Exact research memory under a fixed inference budget
tracks.question: When does selecting exact prior feedback improve task generalization enough to pay for selection?
tracks.application: Reduce inference cost and unwanted actions in assistants that learn from task feedback without importing audit labels.
tracks.contribution: A tested selection or abstention rule with a quality-cost frontier on source-disjoint tasks, rather than another prompt variant on the public 28-case fixture.
tracks.existingEvidence: The task study has replayable fixed, labeled, prompt-grid, feedback, and optional context-feedback arms. Its historical live study reused 12 audit cases; labeled examples matched feedback at lower cost. The selector has workflow tests, not a measured quality advantage.
baselines: recency and seeded random retrieval at matched context bytes
metrics: total calls and tokens including selection and losing candidates
estimated cost and latency with hardware/provider identities
tracks.nextExperiment: First freeze a harder, licensed or owner-authorized, source-group-disjoint corpus and demonstrate baseline headroom without viewing final labels. Preregister a quality noninferiority margin and a cost-saving target in task units; compare selection against recency and random retrieval at matched bytes. Keep the published synthetic corpus as a regression fixture only.
tracks.confirmation: Select on development/validation only. Evaluate once on untouched task families with paired per-task differences and uncertainty; repeated model calls on one item are not independent items. Replicate on another machine and, if a cross-model claim is intended, another independently authorized model.
tracks.priorArt: Read primary work on retrieval-augmented generation, few-shot example selection, prompt optimization including GEPA, and agent memory. Record source version, theorem or experiment location, assumptions, actual comparison, and whether the proposed rule is a direct application. Priority is unresolved.
tracks.stop: Stop when simple labeled or random-retrieval controls match the candidate, the preregistered practical margin is missed, held-out contamination occurs, or the campaign allowance is consumed. Preserve null results; do not buy more calls by creating a new run.

tracks.title: Certified allocation rules under operational constraints
tracks.question: Which useful extensions of the softmax allocation model retain tractable optimization or certified approximation?
tracks.application: Allocate finite workers or replicas to tasks with eligibility, capacity, and assignment costs, only where the workload supports the model assumptions.
tracks.contribution: A new tractability boundary, approximation guarantee, or exact reduction with a reusable implementation. The current min-cost-flow algorithm and fractional-optimization machinery are established methods, not novelty claims.
tracks.existingEvidence: The additive model has an exact rational flow solver with a residual certificate; positive-temperature occupancy optimization has certified regret bounds. These support model-specific conclusions, not measured production scheduling gains.
baselines: an independently implemented solver on the same objective
metrics: feasibility and exact objective or certified regret
runtime and peak memory by input size
application service objective and deployment overhead
tracks.nextExperiment: Choose one constraint demanded by a documented workload, such as uncertain rewards or switching cost. Specify the model change, falsifiable theorem or counterexample, and smallest exact controls. Test whether the existing reduction already solves it before building a new optimizer.
tracks.confirmation: Check the proof independently and compare exhaustive small-instance optima, infeasible cases, and certificate mutations. Freeze solver and limits before larger unseen instances and a versioned public or authorized workload trace; report mismatch between the mathematical objective and the operational objective.
tracks.priorArt: Read primary sources on min-cost flow, separable concave allocation, fractional programming, discrete convexity, and the exact nonlinear model. Map substitutions into existing theorems and distinguish a new application from a new algorithm. Priority is unresolved.
tracks.stop: Stop or reclassify as an application when a known theorem subsumes the contribution. Stop the practical claim if model assumptions fail, greedy is adequate at the declared margin, or certificate checking costs exceed the intended use.

tracks.title: Recoverable execution with uncertain external effects
tracks.question: Can a portable recovery protocol reduce recovery cost while preserving explicit uncertainty and preventing duplicate non-idempotent effects?
tracks.application: Run long research jobs across process failures and machine handoffs without silently repeating paid calls or external writes.
tracks.contribution: A precisely scoped recovery protocol, counterexample, or measured implementation tradeoff. Local single-writer locks and no-retry journals alone are established engineering patterns, not distributed exactly-once execution.
tracks.existingEvidence: Bun and OTP hosts passed local lifecycle fixtures with identical successful receipts. The findings concern one shared machine and exclude a production durability or general performance ranking.
baselines: durable intent plus no automatic retry
provider idempotency where an authorized provider actually guarantees it
metrics: throughput and total host plus worker memory
tracks.nextExperiment: Freeze a failure model and effect contract, enumerate crashes around every intent/effect/result persistence boundary, and build an independent effect-log oracle. Add machine-transfer and delayed-result fixtures before considering a protocol change; run no real external mutations.
tracks.confirmation: Require zero duplicate fixture effects and no fabricated success in the declared failure matrix. Randomize order across independent process runs and repeat on another OS/machine. Distributed ownership and power-loss durability need separate models and tests.
tracks.priorArt: Compare primary work on write-ahead logging, idempotency keys, transactional outboxes, message delivery semantics, distributed fencing, and workflow engines. State which assumptions make any guarantee possible and which established systems already provide it. Priority is unresolved.
tracks.stop: Stop dispatch at an unresolved effect or unproven ownership transition. Reject a speedup that drops persistence or uncertainty checks. Do not migrate the runtime based on one host benchmark.

tracks.title: Search guided by independently checked obstructions
tracks.question: Can reusable obstruction certificates reduce search work on unseen instances more than ordinary pruning at the same total budget?
tracks.application: Reduce the cost of exact combinatorial optimization or constraint solving while keeping a small independent result checker.
tracks.contribution: A generalizable pruning rule or proof-compression method with soundness evidence and an end-to-end search/checking tradeoff, rather than another isolated finite record.
tracks.existingEvidence: The repository has exact construction verifiers and portable Ramsey certificates. Exclusions apply only to their stated graph families and do not settle the broader Ramsey problem.
baselines: the frozen solver without learned obstructions
standard symmetry breaking and established solver preprocessing
unseeded search at the full seeded-search budget
metrics: search nodes and total CPU including learning
proof bytes and independent checking time
tracks.nextExperiment: Choose one certificate family, prove the exact soundness condition for reuse, and make small satisfiable and unsatisfiable controls. Freeze a disjoint instance-family split and include the cost of learning and checking obstructions in the comparison.
tracks.confirmation: Freeze the rule before unseen instance families and a second-machine reproduction. Independently verify every returned certificate, audit excluded cases, and count timeouts and unsolved cases in the denominator. Search failure is never an impossibility proof.
tracks.priorArt: Read primary sources on clause learning, proof logging, symmetry breaking, cutting planes, and certificate compression. Compare to the underlying solver before claiming a new method; novelty of a numerical record is separate from algorithm novelty. Priority is unresolved.
tracks.stop: Stop if an obstruction rejects a satisfiable control, existing preprocessing subsumes it, checking erases the saved search cost, or the finite allowance ends. Do not repeat exhausted moonshot searches or release held audit findings.
